Alger, 11 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 11, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Xiaomi Algeria is preparing to unveil its new smartphone lineup, the #Xiaomi13ProSeries, promising major innovations in photography and customization.
La firme prépare l'arrivée de la #Xiaomi: The company is preparing the arrival of the #Xiaomi13ProSeries, highlighting cutting-edge technology with an innovative rear display and a 200-megapixel dual-camera system developed in partnership with Leica. These new models aim to redefine the standards of mobile photography and device customization. Two device sizes will be offered, each providing an advanced user experience.
Le lancement officiel aura lieu lors de: The official launch will take place during the #XiaomiLaunch event in Paris on November 17 at 2:00 PM (Paris time, GMT+1). Additional announcements are expected on this occasion.
